title: Supply Chain Analyst - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for a Supply Chain Analyst to join our team and help drive our growth. As a Supply Chain Analyst, you will play a critical and active role in the day-to-day operations. This is an excellent opportunity to be one of the key members of our team and position yourself for unique career growth opportunities.


Key responsibilities:


- Determine supply needs for products and services and research potential suppliers.

- Act as a link and communicate pricing and performance needs to vendors and suppliers.

- Participate in negotiations of favorable procurement contracts and prices with selected vendors and suppliers.

- Select the most suitable suppliers in terms of reliability, product quality, and cost-efficiency.

- Maintain and update a list of suppliers and their qualifications, delivery times, and potential future development.

- Prepare cost-benefit analysis reports for review by managers.


Requirements:


- 2+ years of experience in a supply management role or related position.

- Knowledge of SAP or SAP B1.

- Degree in supply chain management, logistics, business management, or related fields.

- Experience in managing inventory.

- Proficiency in SQL analysis tools and mathematical analysis.

- Interpersonal skills and ability to build and improve trust.

- Advanced level of English.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

title: Analista Funcional de IA Sênior (Remoto)
description:
Olá!

A Aggrandize nasceu em 2015 com a missão de engrandecer pessoas e negócios . Guiados por valores como adaptabilidade, colaboração, foco no cliente e visão de dono, oferecemos soluções que transformam desafios em oportunidades.

Somos especialistas em Platform Engineering , Data Analytics , Modern Applications e Cybersecurity , sempre com o compromisso de impulsionar o crescimento e a inovação de nossos parceiros.

Nosso trabalho é mais do que tecnologia; é sobre potencializar resultados. Increase the power of your business .


Agora que você conhece a cultura Aggrandize, saiba mais sobre a oportunidade:


Atuação em um ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo, com foco em soluções inovadoras baseadas em Inteligência Artificial e evolução contínua de produtos digitais.


❇️ O seu papel no time:

  • Levantar, analisar e documentar requisitos funcionais de soluções com uso de IA;
  • Traduzir demandas de negócio em especificações claras, fluxos e critérios de aceite;
  • Apoiar o desenho de jornadas, regras de negócio e casos de uso;
  • Atuar em conjunto com times de produto, tecnologia, UX e operação;
  • Participar da validação de entregas, testes funcionais e processos de homologação;
  • Documentar processos, fluxos, funcionalidades e regras associadas às soluções;
  • Apoiar o acompanhamento de backlog e priorização de demandas;
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria em processos e experiências apoiadas por IA;
  • Contribuir com a evolução contínua das soluções em produção.


❇️ O que esperamos de você - Hard Skills:

  • Experiência com LLMs, chatbots ou agentes inteligentes;
  • Conhecimento em fluxos conversacionais;
  • Noções de APIs, automações e integrações;
  • Experiência com testes de IA e análise de respostas;
  • Vivência com ferramentas como Jira, Confluence, Miro ou Figma;
  • Experiência em metodologias ágeis;
  • Conhecimento em ambientes de cloud como Google Cloud e Azure;
  • Conhecimento em Databricks.


❇️ O que esperamos de você - Soft Skills:

  • Adaptabilidade;
  • Colaboração;
  • Foco no cliente;
  • Visão de dono.


✨O que oferecemos (modalidade CLT):

  • VR/VA de R$38/dia (cartão flexível);
  • Auxílio flex de R$210/mês (cartão flexível);
  • TotalPass;
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • PLR;
  • Day off de aniversário;
  • Treinamentos e certificações custeadas pela Aggrandize;
  • Programa de indicação premiada;
  • Trilha de carreira.

title: Back End Developer With Data Exp
description:
Role: Data Engineer III (API) / Software Engineer with Data Experience

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Mode: Contract


Important:

We need a senior-level engineer with recent hands-on experience in Node.js and strong expertise in MongoDB, TypeScript, SQL, AWS, and API development .

Experience with GraphQL is a plus .


About the Role

We are looking for a highly skilled backend/data engineer with strong experience in building scalable APIs and working with complex data systems.

This role focuses on Node.js, TypeScript, backend architecture, and data modeling , with exposure to cloud-native and event-driven systems .


Responsibilities

• Build and maintain scalable APIs (REST & GraphQL) for high-performance applications

• Design and optimize data models using MongoDB, NoSQL, and relational databases

• Implement schema design, indexing strategies, and transactions for performance and scalability

• Develop and maintain ETL pipelines and data ingestion workflows

• Collaborate on backend architecture , including microservices and distributed systems

• Work with cloud platforms (AWS/OCI) and containerized environments (Docker/Kubernetes)

• Ensure code quality, testing, and best engineering practices across the development lifecycle


Requirements

• 6+ years of experience in software engineering or data engineering

• Strong hands-on experience with Node.js and TypeScript (recent projects required)

• Expertise in MongoDB and database modeling (NoSQL + SQL)

• Solid experience building REST APIs (GraphQL is a plus)

• Strong understanding of software engineering principles (SOLID, clean architecture, design patterns)

• Experience with AWS (Lambda, S3, etc.) or OCI

• Experience with containers (Docker/Kubernetes)

• Strong problem-solving and communication skills


Nice to Have

• Experience with GraphQL APIs

• Messaging systems like Kafka, RabbitMQ, or SQS/SNS

• Experience with event-driven architecture

• Exposure to serverless architectures

• Experience with CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, etc.)


Apply today or share your profiles to

title: Forensic Manager
description:
This leading multinational group, with significant operations across the Americas and worldwide, is seeking an experienced Forensic Manager to lead a team of corporate investigators across their regional operations.


Based in Belo Horizonte, you will be responsible for managing a team of forensic specialists who are overseeing investigations into complex financial crimes, including conflict-of-interest, procurement fraud, misappropriation of assets, corruption, and bribery.


Your role will be primarily focused on team leadership, setting key performance objectives, and building strategic relationships to ensure seamless regional operations. You will have day-to-day responsibility for managing forensic specialists, providing career development guidance, and overseeing resource allocation. Furthermore, you will serve as the primary point of contact for operational management while playing a key role in the overall strategic management of the group’s investigative objectives.


In addition to your leadership duties, you will undertake high-level corporate investigation projects, conduct fraud awareness training, and oversee the integration of data analytics into investigative workflows.


To be successful in this role, you should possess extensive experience in leading complex corporate investigations and managing specialized forensic teams. You are likely currently working in a managerial capacity within a forensic advisory firm or a comparable corporate business.


While a CFE qualification is highly welcomed, we value your proven ability to lead high-performance teams and manage senior stakeholder relationships. Excellent communication skills are essential, and candidates must be fluent in both Portuguese and English. Proficiency in Spanish and experience with advanced data analytics tools are welcomed.


For more information, please see our video

title: Young Professional – IT Recruiter - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role


The Young Professional – IT Recruiter position focuses on launching your career in talent acquisition within a global tech company. This role involves supporting end-to-end recruitment processes and developing sourcing and interviewing skills alongside experienced recruiters. You'll participate in the full recruitment cycle from job posting and sourcing to screening and interview coordination while building talent pipelines and collaborating with hiring teams.


Key responsibilities


- Supporting the full recruitment cycle, from job posting and sourcing to screening and interview coordination.

- Sourcing candidates through job boards, LinkedIn, and other platforms to build a strong talent pipeline.

- Reviewing resumes and conducting initial screening calls to assess candidate profiles and interest.

- Coordinating interviews between candidates and hiring managers, ensuring a smooth experience for all parties.

- Maintaining and updating candidate records in the ATS, keeping data accurate and up to date.

- Collaborating with senior recruiters and hiring teams to understand role requirements and refine search strategies.


Requirements


- Educational Background: Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Psychology, Business, or a related field — or currently pursuing one.

- Career Interest: Strong interest in IT recruitment and talent acquisition.

- Professional Attitude: Proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple tasks simultaneously.

- Core Skills: Good communication and interpersonal skills.

- Language Proficiency: Advanced level of English.



Benefits:

- Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

- Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

- Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

- Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

- Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

- Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

- Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

- Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for Java Developers to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.


Key responsibilities:


- Work with software development teams to gather requirements and ensure best practices are adhered.

- Design, Implement & Support solutions for application development, security, analytics and performance management.

- Conform to existing industry security coding standards adhering to fortify scan and other security tool review requirements.

- Conduct code reviews for junior members of the team and do peer code reviews to make sure code is following standards set forward by the architects.

- Run test scripts against code to ensure quality delivery.

- Resolve code issues with urgency.


Requirements:


- 5+ years of experience in Java.

- Experience in web application programming.

- Knowledge of Object Oriented Programming.

- Ability to work with relational and non-relational bases.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

- Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

- Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

- Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

- Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

- Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

- Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

- Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

- Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Senior Java Software Engineer
description:
Senior Software Engineer (Java / AI-Enabled)

Rocket Financial builds innovative fintech products that improve how money moves globally. We work across multiple high-impact fintech projects , tackling complex problems in payments, infrastructure, and financial services.


We are a U.S.-based company hiring an international contractor located in Brazil . This role will work closely with a distributed team, including Brazil and Canada based engineers.


We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer who is primarily backend-focused but comfortable contributing to the frontend when needed. You’ll play a key role in shaping systems, building scalable applications, and leveraging AI tools to move faster and smarter.


WHY JOIN US

  • Fast-paced startup environment with high impact and real ownership
  • 100% fully remote role
  • Work with a U.S.-based company building cutting-edge fintech products
  • Flexible schedule with alignment to East Coast hours
  • Collaborative, international team with strong engineering talent
  • Opportunity to work with modern technologies and AI-driven development


WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Build and scale Java-based backend systems and microservices
  • Contribute to frontend features (React or similar) when needed
  • Design robust, scalable applications and system architectures
  • Use AI tools (Claude, Codex, etc.) to accelerate development and problem-solving
  • Write and refine effective AI prompts for engineering workflows
  • Collaborate closely with Product and Design to deliver impactful features
  • Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and agile processes
  • Debug and resolve production issues and performance challenges


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience (strong backend focus in Java)
  • Experience with Spring, microservices, and REST APIs
  • Comfortable working across the stack (React/TypeScript or similar )
  • Hands-on experience with AI coding tools (Claude, Codex, etc.)
  • Strong system design and problem-solving skills
  • Experience with PostgreSQL, Docker, CI/CD, and AWS
  • Able to thrive in a fast-moving environment and adapt quickly

title: Remote SwarmBench Task Engineer - 75063
description:
About Turing:


Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Role Overview:

We are looking for a SwarmBench Task Engineer specializing in planning and operations to design and build complex, multi-agent benchmark tasks that simulate real-world planning, scheduling, and operational decision-making scenarios. This role focuses on creating constraint-rich problems that evaluate multi-agent reasoning, decomposition, and optimization capabilities in realistic environments.


What does day-to-day life look like?

  • Design and develop multi-agent benchmark tasks involving:
  • Planning, scheduling, and resource allocation
  • Operational decision-making (project management, logistics, incident response, capacity planning)
  • Create constraint-rich problem statements with multiple interacting variables
  • Develop verification scripts to evaluate:
  • Feasibility (all constraints satisfied)
  • Completeness (all requirements addressed)
  • Optimality (efficient solutions)
  • Build decomposition strategies:
  • Split tasks across specialized sub-agents (resource-based, constraint-based, conflict resolution, optimization)
  • Model real-world operational scenarios with dependencies, timelines, and resource constraints
  • Collaborate on improving task quality, coverage, and evaluation rigor


Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience in operations, project management, logistics, or supply chain
  • Strong ability to formalize constraints, dependencies, and scheduling logic
  • Proficiency in Python for building verification and validation scripts
  • Strong structured problem-solving and decomposition skills
  • Clear and precise technical writing skills
  • Experience with AI coding benchmarks (e.g., SWE-bench, Terminal-bench)
  • Hands-on experience with Docker (Dockerfiles, image builds, debugging)


Nice to have:

  • Experience with optimization techniques (linear programming, constraint satisfaction, scheduling algorithms)
  • Background in operations research
  • Experience with simulation or modeling tools
  • Knowledge of AI planning systems or automated reasoning
  • Project management experience or certifications (PMP, Agile, etc.)


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: 40 hours per week with overlap of 4 hours with PST.
  • Engagement Type: Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of Contract: 4 weeks (adjustable based on engagement)
  • Location : Bangladesh, Brazil, Colombia, Egypt, Ghana, India, Indonesia, Kenya, Nigeria, Turkey, Vietnam


Evaluation Process:

  • Take home assessment


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Electrical Engineering Pod Lead - 72132
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Job Overview:

An Electrical Engineering Pod Lead responsible for managing a small team creating simulation-based design problems used to train and evaluate advanced AI models. The role owns problem quality, reproducible environments, and coordination with AI researchers , and requires strong EE domain depth plus hands-on Python, Docker, and basic cloud skills to review and support the pod end-to-end.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Team Leadership
  • Lead and manage a pod of 4–8 Engineering Design Specialists by assigning tasks, reviewing deliverables, removing blockers, and mentoring on problem design, simulation rigor, and documentation.
  • Act as the main point of contact with AI research teams to translate model feedback into refinements, while running regular syncs, tracking progress, and reporting updates and risks to program leads.
  • Technical Oversight
  • Oversee and approve pod outputs, maintain reproducible Docker-based simulation environments, support cloud infrastructure for simulation/grading,
  • Develop and review Python automation/validation, and proactively resolve dependency, versioning, and reproducibility issues.
  • Problem Design (Individual Contribution)
  • Personally design a portfolio of high-difficulty electrical engineering problems in your chosen subdomain.
  • Set the quality bar and design philosophy for the pod through your own example submissions.


Electrical Engineering Subdomains:

You must have deep expertise in at least one of the following, with working familiarity across others being a strong plus:

  • Analog / Mixed-Signal IC Design — op-amp topologies, ADC/DAC design, noise analysis, layout-aware design, SPICE-level simulation.
  • Power Electronics — DC-DC converters, inverter design, magnetics sizing, thermal management, efficiency optimization.
  • RF / Microwave Engineering — filter design, impedance matching, S-parameter analysis, transmission line and antenna design.
  • Digital Systems / FPGA / ASIC — RTL design, timing closure, synthesis-aware design, hardware-software co-design.
  • Embedded Systems — microcontroller/DSP-based design, real-time constraints, peripheral interfacing, power budgeting.


Required Qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline.
  • At least 5 years of hands-on electrical engineering design experience, with a track record of owning designs from specification through validated implementation.
  • At least 1–2 years of experience in a technical lead, senior engineer, or team coordination role.
  • Proficiency with Python for scripting, automation, and simulation workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with Docker: building images, writing Dockerfiles, managing containerized environments.
  • Familiarity with at least one cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) — comfortable running workloads, managing storage, and monitoring jobs.
  • Proficiency with at least one open-source EE simulation tool (e.g., ngspice, PySpice, Qucs, OpenEMS, scikit-rf, or similar).


Nice-to-Have:

  • Experience designing engineering coursework, exam problems, or design challenges at graduate level.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines or automated testing frameworks.
  • Exposure to LLM evaluation, AI benchmarking, or training data curation.
  • Cross-domain familiarity with Control Systems, Embedded/Robotics, or Power Systems.


Evaluation Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form .
  • Shortlisted candidates will receive a Job Interest Form . After the initial profile review, we will share an assessment , which must be completed within 24 hours . Based on the assessment submission and your responses, we may schedule an interview round .
  • Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements .



After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Senior Software Engineer (L3) - Healthcare Tech Nonprofit


Want your code to actually matter?

We're hiring on behalf of a mission-driven healthcare technology nonprofit whose platform has reached tens of millions of patients in low-income communities across the US. They're growing the team that builds the SaaS product hundreds of safety-net clinics rely on every day to manage patients and run patient engagement programs.


This is a senior IC role with shared team-lead responsibilities - owning complex full-stack features end-to-end, mentoring mid-level engineers, and shaping architecture across a Rails monolith and React SPA.


The Stack Ruby on Rails · React · TypeScript · PostgreSQL · Google Cloud · Sidekiq


What You'll Own

  • Driving the technical direction of key Applications platform features
  • Shipping full-stack work end-to-end: API → data model → UI
  • Mentoring L2 engineers and leading technical design discussions
  • Contributing to architectural decisions across the monolith and SPA
  • Sharing on-call duties and helping evolve engineering standards


What We're Looking For

  • 8+ years full-stack experience, with deep Rails + modern React fluency
  • A track record of owning complex features from design through production
  • Advanced SQL and a genuinely analytical, evidence-led mindset
  • Proven ability to mentor and influence technical direction
  • Excellent async communication — this is a fully distributed team
  • Real excitement about mission-driven work


Bonus Points

  • Healthcare tech, social services, or other practitioner-facing domains
  • Multi-tenant data models, RBAC, accessibility-aware UI
  • Experience scaling a Rails monolith with a React SPA frontend


Interested? Apply here or message me directly - happy to walk you through the role, the team, and the mission before you commit to a full process.

description:
Senior Software Engineer (L3) - Healthcare Tech Nonprofit


Want your code to actually matter?

We're hiring on behalf of a mission-driven healthcare technology nonprofit whose platform has reached tens of millions of patients in low-income communities across the US. They're growing the team that builds the SaaS product hundreds of safety-net clinics rely on every day to manage patients and run patient engagement programs.


This is a senior IC role with shared team-lead responsibilities - owning complex full-stack features end-to-end, mentoring mid-level engineers, and shaping architecture across a Rails monolith and React SPA.


The Stack Ruby on Rails · React · TypeScript · PostgreSQL · Google Cloud · Sidekiq


What You'll Own

  • Driving the technical direction of key Applications platform features
  • Shipping full-stack work end-to-end: API → data model → UI
  • Mentoring L2 engineers and leading technical design discussions
  • Contributing to architectural decisions across the monolith and SPA
  • Sharing on-call duties and helping evolve engineering standards


What We're Looking For

  • 8+ years full-stack experience, with deep Rails + modern React fluency
  • A track record of owning complex features from design through production
  • Advanced SQL and a genuinely analytical, evidence-led mindset
  • Proven ability to mentor and influence technical direction
  • Excellent async communication — this is a fully distributed team
  • Real excitement about mission-driven work


Bonus Points

  • Healthcare tech, social services, or other practitioner-facing domains
  • Multi-tenant data models, RBAC, accessibility-aware UI
  • Experience scaling a Rails monolith with a React SPA frontend


Interested? Apply here or message me directly - happy to walk you through the role, the team, and the mission before you commit to a full process.

title: Analista de dados
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Dados que vá além de números — alguém capaz de transformar dados em insights estratégicos e apoiar decisões que impactam diretamente o crescimento do negócio.

Se você tem olhar analítico, curiosidade e gosta de encontrar padrões onde outros veem apenas dados, essa oportunidade é para você.

RESPONSABILIDADES

Coletar, organizar e analisar dados de diferentes fontes

Criar dashboards e relatórios para acompanhamento de performance

Identificar padrões, tendências e oportunidades de melhoria

Apoiar equipes de marketing, produto e negócios com insights acionáveis

Monitorar KPIs e sugerir otimizações baseadas em dados

Trabalhar com grandes volumes de dados garantindo qualidade e consistência

Automatizar processos e relatórios sempre que possível

REQUISITOS

Experiência prévia como Analista de Dados ou função similar

Forte habilidade analítica e raciocínio lógico

Conhecimento em ferramentas como Excel/Google Sheets, SQL e ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Tableau, etc.)

Noções de estatística e interpretação de dados

Capacidade de traduzir dados em insights claros e objetivos

Organização, atenção aos detalhes e proatividade

DIFERENCIAIS

Experiência com Python ou R para análise de dados

Conhecimento em Google Analytics, BigQuery ou ferramentas de tracking

Experiência em ambientes de marketing ou produto

BENEFÍCIOS

Remuneração compatível com o mercado

Bônus por desempenho (conforme política da empresa)

Ambiente colaborativo, orientado a dados e inovação

Oportunidades de crescimento e desenvolvimento profissional

title: Engenheiro(a) de Dados Sênior | Databricks e Inglês Avançado
description:
Muito prazer, somos a United Hub Digital, uma consultoria de tecnologia nearshore que combina inovação, excelência técnica e agilidade para transformar negócios

Na UHub, somos impulsionados pelo propósito de liderar a transformação digital com excelência e agilidade. A flexibilidade é uma das nossas marcas registradas. Atuamos com diferentes modelos e formatos de time, adaptando-nos ao contexto de cada cliente. Nosso diferencial está em entregar soluções de ponta com uma equipe enxuta, eficiente e com mentalidade de dono.

O Que Você Vai Fazer

Estamos procurando um Senior Databricks Engineer com experiência na construção de pipelines e desenvolvimento de processos ETL no Databricks para agregar ao nosso Databricks CoE. Nesta função, você desempenhará um papel essencial na interseção entre negócios e tecnologia, combinando profundo conhecimento técnico com a capacidade de alinhar soluções tecnológicas aos objetivos estratégicos da empresa.

O Que Estamos Buscando

  • Inglês Avançado/Fluente;
  • 5+ anos de experiência com manipulação e engenharia de dados
  • 5+ anos com processos ETL
  • 3+ anos de experiência com Databricks
  • 3+ anos de experiência com Azure
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban)
  • Excelente comunicação e colaboração em equipe
  • Esta função pode gerar oportunidades de viagens domésticas e/ou internacionais;

Será Um Diferencial Se Você

  • Vivência em projetos internacionais e equipes multiculturais
  • Experiência com Power BI e integração entre engenharia e BI
  • Curiosidade e desejo de se envolver em diferentes etapas do ciclo de dados (desde ingestão até visualização)

Onde Você Vai Trabalhar

  • Esta é uma posição para atuação 100% remota

Modalidade De Contratação

  • CLT ou PJ.

title: Direct-Response Creative Strategist
description:
About us

Clickbait Agency is a YouTube ad creative and media buying agency. We only work with 8 and 9-figure DTC brands and our focus is simple, producing video creatives that scale profitably on YouTube and this means that you’ll be working directly on accounts most agencies don’t get near.

We care deeply about being the best at what we do which means fast iteration, high standards, and creatives that spend millions. We’ve built proprietary AI systems that support our creative and production workflows, and our video production runs through a dedicated team of AI prompters, so strategists can stay focused on strategy.

We think YouTube creative is going through a significant shift right now and we’re positioning ourselves at the front of it.


The role

We’re looking for a creative strategist who understands direct response at a serious level and can develop and script YouTube ads and mini VSLs for competitive ecommerce markets.

You’ll be responsible for research, angle development, hook writing, scripting, and iterating based on performance data. Your scripts go through our AI production team, so the output is fast and the feedback loop is short.

You’ll be working across multiple 8 and 9-figure brands simultaneously. The work is demanding and the bar is high.


What we’re looking for

We’re only looking for people who are genuinely good at this. If you’re earlier in your career or still developing your DR fundamentals, this isn’t the right fit yet.

You should have:

  • 2+ years writing direct response video ads for YouTube or Facebook
  • A real understanding of Eugene Schwartz’s awareness stages and how to apply them to cold traffic
  • Experience scripting hooks, mini VSLs, and full ad concepts
  • The ability to look at performance data and use it to build the next creative
  • Proven spend behind your work — creatives you’ve written that have run profitably at scale
  • Comfort using AI tools as part of your day-to-day workflow

Experience in compliance-sensitive categories like supplements or weight loss is a bonus. So is familiarity with unique mechanism development and RMBC.


What we offer

Base salary with a performance bonus tied to winning creatives. When your work scales, your compensation reflects that.

You’ll have access to proprietary AI tools built specifically for our workflow, a production team that handles execution, and a team around you that takes the work seriously.

This is a fully remote position.


One thing worth knowing

There’s a short test task as part of the application process. It’s there to see how you think, not to take your time for nothing.

title: ESPECIALISTA EM ENGENHARIA DE DADOS | REMOTO
description:
LOCALIZA&CO

Estar em constante evolução nos trouxe até aqui. Ao lado de talentos e habilidades múltiplas nos conectamos em busca da nossa motivação: construir o futuro da mobilidade sustentável. É por meio da valorização da individualidade de cada um que impulsionamos o nosso movimento para conquistar resultados extraordinários, desenvolver nossas operações e criar soluções para os nossos clientes.

Somos apaixonados por nossa história, por nossas ideias e pela capacidade de realizá-las. Sabemos que juntos, todos vamos mais longe.

É assim que conectamos a Localiza&Co com o futuro.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Projetar, desenvolver e implementar pipelines robustas, conectando dados de diversas fontes utilizando principalmente ferramentas do ecossistema AWS;
  • Implementar soluções de enriquecimento de dados escaláveis e eficientes utilizando o DBT para transformar dados brutos em modelos de dados personalizados e insights acionáveis para o negócio;
  • Gerenciar integrações, processos de transformação e automações de tarefas usando conectores de dados, APIs SQL, Python e Rest;
  • Utilizar SQL para consultas e manipulação de dados em bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais;
  • Aplicar Spark para processamento de grandes volumes de dados em tempo real e em batch.


Requisitos e qualificações

  • AWS (Athena, S3, Glue, Lambda);
  • Proficiência em SQL, DBT, Python e Spark.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de orquestração de dados como Apache Airflow;
  • Conhecimentos sobre diferentes técnicas de arquitetura e modelagem de dados para fins analíticos (Ex.: Data Mesh, Data Mart, Data Lake, Data Warehouse);
  • Experiência com Modelagem de Dados (relacional e/ou analítico) e processos ETL;
  • APIs, Gateways, Micro Serviços e Containers;
  • Noções sobre boas práticas de engenharia de software (Documentação, testes automatizados, código limpo, monitoramento).


Diferenciais:

  • Possuir Certificações AWS associadas à função de Cloud Data Engineer, sendo elas:
  • Cloud Practitioner;
  • Data Engineer;
  • Solutions Architect;
  • Machine Learning Engineer.


BENEFÍCIOS DESSA POSIÇÃO

  • Participação nos Lucros
  • Carro Corporativo
  • Vale Alimentação
  • Vale Refeição
  • Convênio Médico
  • Convênio Odontológico
  • Gympass
  • Previdência Privada
  • Auxílio Home Office
  • Allya
  • Acesso ilimitado a diversos cursos da nossa Universidade Localiza
  • Programas internos de treinamento e desenvolvimento
  • Desconto em compra e aluguel de veículos

É por meio da valorização da individualidade de cada um que impulsionamos o nosso movimento para conquistar resultados extraordinários, desenvolver nossas operações e criar soluções para os nossos clientes.

Somos apaixonados por nossa história, por nossas ideias e pela capacidade de realizá-las. Sabemos que juntos, todos vamos mais longe.

É assim que conectamos a Localiza&Co com o futuro.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Projetar, desenvolver e implementar pipelines robustas, conectando dados de diversas fontes utilizando principalmente ferramentas do ecossistema AWS;
  • Implementar soluções de enriquecimento de dados escaláveis e eficientes utilizando o DBT para transformar dados brutos em modelos de dados personalizados e insights acionáveis para o negócio;
  • Gerenciar integrações, processos de transformação e automações de tarefas usando conectores de dados, APIs SQL, Python e Rest;
  • Utilizar SQL para consultas e manipulação de dados em bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais;
  • Aplicar Spark para processamento de grandes volumes de dados em tempo real e em batch.


Requisitos e qualificações

  • AWS (Athena, S3, Glue, Lambda);
  • Proficiência em SQL, DBT, Python e Spark.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de orquestração de dados como Apache Airflow;
  • Conhecimentos sobre diferentes técnicas de arquitetura e modelagem de dados para fins analíticos (Ex.: Data Mesh, Data Mart, Data Lake, Data Warehouse);
  • Experiência com Modelagem de Dados (relacional e/ou analítico) e processos ETL;
  • APIs, Gateways, Micro Serviços e Containers;
  • Noções sobre boas práticas de engenharia de software (Documentação, testes automatizados, código limpo, monitoramento).


Diferenciais:

  • Possuir Certificações AWS associadas à função de Cloud Data Engineer, sendo elas:
  • Cloud Practitioner;
  • Data Engineer;
  • Solutions Architect;
  • Machine Learning Engineer.

title: Process Data & Integration Specialist - Remote Work
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role


The Accounting Analyst position serves as the key internal contact for the company's financial information, with full visibility of transactions and responsibility for the source data used in decision-making. This role involves participating in regular monthly closing cycles and contributing to the development of the accounting work frame. You'll understand the financial data management model and use appropriate data retrieval tools to prepare and process accounting information in a highly versatile team that constantly adapts to changing business needs.


Key responsibilities


- Reconciling accounts.

- Verifying cost center allocation and other inputs of accounting transactions.

- Compiling financial statements.

- Registering accruals and applying corrections in the accounting system.

- Generating reports and supporting decision-making processes.


Requirements


- Accounting Experience: Experience in accounting, accounts payable, bookkeeping, or accounts receivable.

- Excel Proficiency: Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including pivot tables and Vlookup.

- ERP Systems: Experience with ERP management systems such as QuickBooks, Xero, SAP, or NetSuite.

- Language Proficiency: Advanced level of English.



Benefits:

- Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

- Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

- Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

- Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

- Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

- Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

- Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

- Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: It Project Manager Intern
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented IT Project Manager Intern to support our technology team in planning, executing, and monitoring projects. This is a great opportunity to gain hands-on experience in project management, work with cross-functional teams, and learn industry best practices in a dynamic environment.


Key Responsibilities

  • Assist in the planning and coordination of IT projects from initiation to delivery
  • Support project managers in defining scope, timelines, and deliverables
  • Track project progress and help maintain project documentation (plans, reports, meeting notes)
  • Participate in team meetings and provide status updates
  • Help identify risks, issues, and dependencies, and support mitigation plans
  • Collaborate with developers, designers, and business stakeholders
  • Assist in organizing project-related communications and documentation
  • Support the use of project management tools (e.g., Jira, Trello, Asana, or similar)


Qualifications

  • Currently pursuing a degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field
  • Strong organizational and time management skills
  • Excellent communication skills (written and verbal)
  • Basic understanding of project management concepts (Agile/Scrum is a plus)
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word) or Google Workspace
  • Ability to work in a team and manage multiple tasks simultaneously
  • Proactive, eager to learn, and detail-oriented


Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban)
  • Experience with project management tools (Jira, ClickUp, Monday.com, etc.)
  • Basic technical knowledge (software development lifecycle, APIs, etc.)


What You’ll Gain

  • Hands-on experience in IT project management
  • Exposure to real-world technology projects
  • Mentorship from experienced professionals
  • Opportunity to develop communication, leadership, and organizational skills

title: Senior Product Designer — Branding, UX/UI & SaaS Systems
description:
Strategy Analytics está desenvolvendo um ecossistema financeiro e tecnológico proprietário focado em infraestrutura digital, experiências SaaS, dashboards analíticos, branding institucional e interfaces de alta sofisticação visual.


Buscamos um Senior Product Designer com domínio avançado de Figma, UX/UI, branding e construção de sistemas visuais escaláveis.


A pessoa participará diretamente da criação da linguagem visual da empresa, estruturação de design systems, interfaces administrativas, dashboards financeiros, áreas do cliente, landing pages e arquitetura visual de produtos digitais proprietários.


Procuramos alguém com forte capacidade estética, pensamento sistêmico e experiência real em criação de plataformas modernas e interfaces premium.


Responsabilidades:

• Desenvolvimento de design systems completos

• Criação de interfaces SaaS e dashboards

• UX/UI para sistemas complexos

• Branding e identidade visual institucional

• Estruturação de componentes reutilizáveis

• Prototipação avançada no Figma

• Arquitetura visual escalável

• Criação de simbologias e linguagem visual proprietária


Diferenciais:

• Experiência em fintechs ou sistemas financeiros

• Experiência com produtos SaaS complexos

• Noções de front-end

• Motion/UI

• Forte percepção estética minimalista e premium

title: Business Development Representative - Brazil
description:
WHO ARE WE?

We are a bunch of super enthusiastic, passionate, and highly driven people, working to achieve a common goal! We believe that work and the workplace should be joyful and always buzzing with energy!

CloudSEK, one of India’s most trusted Cyber security product companies, is on a mission to build the world’s fastest and most reliable AI technology that identifies and resolves digital threats in real-time. The central proposition is leveraging Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to create a quick and reliable analysis and alert system that provides rapid detection across multiple internet sources, precise threat analysis, and prompt resolution with minimal human intervention.

Founded in 2015, headquartered at Singapore, we are proud to say that we’ve grown at a frenetic pace and have been able to achieve some accolades along the way, including:

CloudSEK’s Product Suite:

  • CloudSEK XVigil constantly maps a customer’s digital assets, identifies threats and enriches them with cyber intelligence, and then provides workflows to manage and remediate all identified threats including takedown support.
  • A powerful Attack Surface Monitoring tool that gives visibility and intelligence on customers’ attack surfaces. CloudSEK's BeVigil uses a combination of Mobile, Web, Network and Encryption Scanners to map and protect known and unknown assets.
  • CloudSEK’s Contextual AI SVigil identifies software supply chain risks by monitoring Software, Cloud Services, and third-party dependencies.


Key Milestones:

  • 2016 : Launched our first product.
  • 2018 : Secured Pre-series A funding.
  • 2019 : Expanded operations to India, Southeast Asia, and the Americas.
  • 2020 : Won the NASSCOM-DSCI Excellence Award for Security Product Company of the Year.
  • 2021 : Raised $7M in Series A funding led by MassMutual Ventures.
  • Awards & Recognition : Won NetApp Excellerator's \"Best Growth Strategy Award,\" CloudSEK XVigil joined NVIDIA Inception Program, and won the NASSCOM Emerge 50 Cybersecurity Award.
  • 2025 : Secured $19 million in funding led by Tenacity Ventures, Commvault.


About the Role:

As a Business Development Representative (BDR), you’ll be at the forefront of CloudSEK’s growth. You’ll identify and qualify high-quality leads, nurture relationships with potential clients, and ultimately contribute to our mission of becoming Asia’s leading cybersecurity company.


Requirements:

  • 1-3 years of experience as an SDR/BDR in a SaaS company. If you have worked in the cybersecurity space, that would be awesome! If not, no worries, most of us are from different industries :)
  • We have a proven track record of successfully generating good quality leads, especially C-level.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, both verbal and written.
  • Excellent phone and email etiquette.
  • Know your way around CRM tools (Salesforce, HubSpot), and data providers (Apollo, Lusha). If not, the team is more than happy to work with you.
  • Self-motivated, results-oriented, and a team player.
  • You are competitive, but with yourself. You set your benchmarks and break them every single quarter.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Prospecting: We will utilize various channels (LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Lusha, Apollo) to identify the right accounts and contacts within our target market.
  • Lead qualification : Assess and qualify leads based on specific criteria, ensuring they align with our ideal customer profile.
  • Lead generation: Multi-channel outreach (cold calling, email, Linkedin, looms..etc) to reach out to potential clients and book introductory meetings with the sales team
  • Relationship building: Build rapport and establish trust with prospects, positioning yourself as a trusted advisor.
  • Pipeline development: Contribute to the sales pipeline by consistently generating qualified leads and opportunities.
  • CRM hygiene: Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all activities and interactions within our CRM system.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with the sales team to ensure a smooth handover of qualified leads and opportunities.
  • Continuous Learning: Stay informed about industry trends, product updates, and competitive landscapes to enhance your outreach.
  • Language: Fluency in English

title: Ingeniero IaC — Terraform & Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)
description:
Sobre a VMetrix

A VMetrix é uma Fintech B2B que está transformando a forma como as instituições financeiras gerenciam investimentos, risco e tesouraria. Nossa plataforma SaaS Front to Back to Risk permite que bancos, seguradoras, gestoras de fundos, corretoras e outras instituições financeiras implementem tecnologia de nível mundial em meses, não em anos, com um modelo flexível e escalável. 

Operamos em múltiplos países e trabalhamos com organizações onde as decisões são tomadas por meio de comitês de compra, licitações e processos altamente rigorosos, em um ambiente onde confiança, reputação e certeza são determinantes.  


O Papel

Você será o arquiteto e guardião da infraestrutura cloud da VMetrix. Automatizará, provisionará e gerenciará todos os recursos OCI por meio do Terraform, garantindo ambientes reproduzíveis, seguros e altamente disponíveis que sustentam nossa plataforma financeira crítica.


Se você é Ex-Oracle ou Ex-OCI, esta vaga foi feita para você. Candidate-se sem hesitar.


Requisitos Eliminatórios - Sem exceção:

Experiência obrigatória

  • 5+ anos em infraestrutura cloud (comprovável)
  • 3+ años trabalhando diretamente com Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)
  • 5+ anos de domínio prático de Terraform (módulos, remote state, workspaces, backends)
  • Graduação em Engenharia da Computação, Redes, Sistemas ou área correlata


OCI — Domínio técnico não negociável

  • Networking: VCN, subnets, Security Lists, NSGs, IGW, NAT GW, Service GW, DRG
  • Compute: VMs, BM, instance pools, autoscaling, custom images
  • Storage: Object Storage, Block Volumes, File Storage, Archive Storage
  • Bancos de dados: Oracle DB 21c EE, Autonomous DB, MySQL HeatWave
  • IAM: compartimentos, políticas, dynamic groups, instance principals
  • OCI DevOps: Code Repos, Build Pipelines, Deployment Pipelines
  • Observabilidade: OCI Monitoring, Logging, Notifications, Events


Terraform & IaC — Domínio avançado

  • Variables, outputs, módulos, remote state, terraform.tfvars, backends OCI Object Storage
  • Gestão de múltiplos workspaces e ambientes (Dev / QA / Prod)
  • Integração com CI/CD: OCI DevOps, GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins ou GitHub Actions
  • Git e GitFlow para versionamento de infraestrutura


Segurança Cloud

  • IAM policies, criptografia KMS/Vault, Audit Service no OCI
  • Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM), CIS Benchmarks para OCI
  • Gestão de segredos: OCI Vault e/ou HashiCorp Vault


Perfil Diferencial — O que coloca você à frente:

  • Ex-funcionário ou ex-contratado da Oracle com experiência em suporte, implementação ou arquitetura OCI → MÁXIMO diferencial do processo
  • Portfólio comprovado em OCI + Terraform (repositórios Git públicos, artigos, open source)
  • Experiência em migrações cloud-to-cloud ou on-premises para OCI
  • Conhecimento de pricing e otimização de custos no OCI
  • Conhecimento de Terragrunt, Ansible ou ferramentas de gerenciamento de configuração
  • Containers: Docker e Kubernetes / OKE
  • Contribuições à comunidade (blog, meetups, palestras sobre OCI ou Terraform)


Certificações - Altamente desejáveis:

  • OCI Architect Professional (1Z0-997)
  • OCI DevOps Professional (1Z0-1109)
  • OCI Security Professional (1Z0-1104)
  • HashiCorp Terraform Associate (003)


Por que trabalhar na VMetrix


En VMetrix não buscamos fazer “mais barulho”, mas construir confiança em um mercado onde as decisões importam. Você terá a oportunidade de liderar uma função estratégica, com autonomia real, impacto direto no negócio e visibilidade executiva.

Você fará parte de uma empresa que está redefinindo como as instituições financeiras adotam tecnologia crítica, em um ambiente desafiador, sofisticado e de alto nível profissional.

Se você se motiva a construir marca, reputação e relacionamentos de longo prazo no coração do sistema financeiro, VMetrix é o lugar certo.


#OCI #Terraform #IaC #OracleCloud #CloudEngineering #LATAM #RemoteWork #VMetrix

description:

• API integration experience with 3rd party companies and systems (JSON,

• Front end skills (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Bootstrap, JQuery, etc)

• GO Development experience

• AWS a plus

Job Description

Responsible for the development and design of web applications and components. Design, code,

test, and implement web sites and applications, for either internal or external uses. Troubleshoot

and resolve issues surrounding performance, response times, capacity and system limitations.

Responsible for creating and modifying documentation corresponding to websites. May

collaborate with internal business partners, internal technology resources (database, system,

networking) and with external vendors. Maintain and update websites and ensure data quality,

integrity and consistency across organization. Requires both front-end (GUI) and back-end

development experience.

Job Details

• Maintenance and feature development for existing Rails 6/7 application Domain focused

on electronic recyclables - inventory, scheduling, transportation, management, and

processing

• API integrations with 3rd party companies and internal applications

Qualifications

• Expert knowledge of the Ruby on Rails framework and Ruby as a core language (10

years minimum)

RPC, XML, etc)

• Working knowledge of basic frontend development (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Bootstrap,

JQuery, etc)

• Working knowledge of Continuous Integration suites (CircleCI, Jenkins, etc)

• Working knowledge of integrated testing frameworks (RSpec, MiniTest, etc)

Education

• 4-year degree or technical training program (bootcamp, etc)

title: SAP OTC Functional Consultant Sr.
description:
Senior SAP OTC Functional Consultant (Mexico & Brazil Only)

We’re not looking for someone to “support SAP.”

We’re looking for someone who owns Order-to-Cash end-to-end and knows how to keep it running under pressure.

If you’ve worked in complex SAP environments (S/4HANA + ECC) , handled real business impact, and can step in without hand-holding—keep reading.


Location: Mexico or Brazil (mandatory)


What You’ll Be Driving

You’ll take full ownership of the Order-to-Cash (O2C) process , ensuring stability, performance, and continuous improvement across the SAP ecosystem.

  • Run and optimize SAP SD processes end-to-end (orders → delivery → billing)
  • Handle pricing, credit checks, ATP, and output without friction
  • Keep integrations with MM, WM, FI and external systems working seamlessly
  • Step in fast when issues hit production—and solve them properly


Where You’ll Make the Difference

This is not a passive role. You’ll be expected to:

  • Challenge and refine business requirements—not just document them
  • Translate needs into clear, executable functional specs
  • Work closely with technical teams to deliver solutions that actually work
  • Lead testing cycles (UAT, regression, impact analysis) with zero surprises
  • Drive user adoption , training, and continuous improvement


What Sets You Apart

  • You’ve already operated as a Senior SAP SD / OTC Consultant
  • You understand the full O2C lifecycle , not just parts of it
  • You’re comfortable with integrations, EDI, and legacy systems
  • You don’t wait for instructions—you take ownership and move things forward
  • You communicate clearly with both business and technical teams


Why This Role

  • Exposure to S/4HANA rollout and transformation projects
  • High visibility across business and IT stakeholders
  • A role where your decisions actually impact operations


If you’re used to stepping into complex environments and making them work—

this is where you prove it.

title: GCP Cloud Architect | Specialist (Remote)
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Conduzir treinamentos técnicos, workshops e palestras (principalmente em espanhol) sobre GCP;
  • Desenvolver demonstrações práticas (hands-on) e provas de conceito (PoCs);
  • Apoiar clientes na adoção de soluções de modernização de aplicações e infraestrutura;
  • Desenhar arquiteturas em nuvem escaláveis, resilientes e seguras;
  • Atuar em estratégias de migração para cloud (cloud migration);
  • Colaborar com times técnicos e de negócio na qualificação de oportunidades;
  • Disseminar boas práticas, tendências e inovações em cloud;
  • Apoiar iniciativas de transformação digital com foco em soluções serverless e cloud-native;
  • Interagir com stakeholders técnicos e de negócio em toda a América Latina.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Experiência sólida com Google Cloud Platform (GCP);
  • Experiência em arquitetura de soluções em cloud e desenho de soluções escaláveis;
  • Vivência com modernização de aplicações e arquiteturas cloud-native e serverless;
  • Experiência com serviços GCP como Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, Cloud Storage, Compute Engine, VPC, IAM, Cloud Load Balancing, Cloud Monitoring e Cloud Logging;
  • Experiência com containers e orquestração, incluindo Docker e Kubernetes / Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE);
  • Conhecimento em infraestrutura como código (IaC), especialmente com Terraform;
  • Experiência com CI/CD e práticas de DevOps;
  • Vivência com migração de ambientes para nuvem (Cloud Migration);
  • Conhecimento em redes (networking) e ambientes Linux;
  • Experiência com observabilidade e monitoramento de sistemas distribuídos;
  • Experiência em gestão e consumo de APIs (API Management);
  • Atuação em arquitetura de soluções (Solution Architecture);
  • Espanhol avançado para condução de apresentações e treinamentos.



Desejáveis:

  • Experiência com Firebase;
  • Conhecimento em BigQuery, Pub/Sub e Dataflow;
  • Experiência com gerenciamento de APIs via Apigee;
  • Vivência com Enterprise Scheduler Service;
  • Experiência com Anthos;
  • Conhecimento em Cloud SQL e Memorystore;
  • Experiência com AI/ML na GCP, incluindo Vertex AI;
  • Conhecimento em Looker;
  • Experiência com Kafka;
  • Vivência com GitOps, incluindo ArgoCD;
  • Conhecimento em Istio;
  • Experiência com FinOps;
  • Práticas de SRE (Site Reliability Engineering);
  • Conhecimento em segurança em cloud (Security Best Practices).

title: Azure DevOps | MID (Remote)
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Projetar e implementar soluções de infraestrutura em Azure, garantindo alta disponibilidade, escalabilidade e segurança;
  • Desenvolver arquiteturas avançadas com foco em contêineres e orquestração utilizando Kubernetes;
  • Colaborar com times de desenvolvimento, operações e segurança na construção de soluções integradas;
  • Avaliar e recomendar tecnologias e ferramentas adequadas para desafios de infraestrutura;

  • Experiência comprovada em arquitetura de soluções com foco em infraestrutura Azure;
  • Sólido conhecimento em serviços Azure, como: Azure Storage (Blob, File, Queue), Azure Networking (VNETs, Subnets, NSG, UDR, VPN Gateway, Application Gateway), Azure Service Bus e Event Grid e Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS);
  • Experiência com automação utilizando PowerShell, Azure CLI ou ferramentas similares;
  • Vivência em gerenciamento e orquestração de contêineres com Kubernetes e Istio;
  • Conhecimento avançado em redes e service mesh;
  • Experiência com práticas de DevOps e CI/CD (Jenkins, GitLab CI, Azure Pipelines);
  • Experiência na construção de soluções resilientes, com alta disponibilidade e tolerância a falhas;
  • Forte habilidade em troubleshooting e resolução de problemas complexos;
  • Boa comunicação, capacidade de apresentação e atuação colaborativa em equipe.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
We are seeking a full-time, remote Full Stack Developer with 3+ years of C# and 2+ years of modern JavaScript framework experience, such as React.js, Angular, or Vue.js, to join the software engineering team of our U.S. client. The right candidate must have a passion for building seriously cool technology, delivering on time, utilizing industry best practices, and working in a fast-paced environment.


Our client is on a mission to make people more productive by providing cloud-based, document management and file sharing solutions that automate routine, repetitive tasks. They are a subsidiary of a publicly traded company that trades on the London Stock Exchange. With hundreds of thousands of users already onboard today, our client is in growth mode, building new products to serve the U.S., the United Kingdom, and Australia / New Zealand markets.


Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop robust, high-quality, front- and back-end product features
  • Develop integrations using external and internal APIs
  • Apply good development practices following team standards, and look for opportunities to improve and innovate
  • Build and execute unit tests
  • Assist the development team in troubleshooting
  • Collaborate with leadership, product management, and other key stakeholders on building a product that wins market share
  • Deliver high-quality code with velocity and provide work estimates based on task complexity
  • Exercise a bias towards action, but understand when to pause and reflect
  • Take pride and interest in your work
  • Work independently with minimal need for oversight, as well as display a willingness to ask questions when needed to remain efficient


Required Experience:

  • Excellent English communication and collaboration skills
  • 3+ years of software development experience using C#
  • 2+ years of experience working with JavaScript frameworks, such as React.js, Angular, or Vue.js
  • Strong front-end skills with proficiency in HTML, CSS3, JavaScript, jQuery, JSON, and AJAX
  • Experience building modern web applications and working with RDBMS, such as MySQL
  • Experience leading a project providing subject matter expertise on personally researched and designed features to colleagues for implementation
  • Background building and consuming REST services
  • Ability and eagerness to learn new skills quickly
  • Solid understanding of programming fundamentals
  • Strong debugging and problem-solving skills
  • Desire to make things better and foster good development practices
  • Background working with designers and within an Agile team
  • Ability to work within coding guidelines
  • Exposure to SaaS software design, development, deployment, and maintenance
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Track record building professional, high-quality, and on-time software


Desired Experience:

  • Experience working with cloud platforms: AWS and Azure
  • Experience in SaaS architecture and design
  • Background in responsive web design
  • Experience in automated testing, TDD, and BDD
  • Experience working with one or more of the following: Entity Framework (or another ORM framework), ElasticSearch, RabbitMQ, CouchBase, Scala, and OAuth 2.0
  • Familiarity with WinForms application development


Additional Information:

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

title: Senior BackEnd Engineer
description:
We are seeking to bring on board a Senior BackEnd Engineer with a deep understanding of Java programming, software development methodologies and the ability to design, develop and maintain complex Java based applications, while also contributing significantly to the technical excellence of the team.


Responsibilities

  • Exceptional problem solving skills to identify and solve complex technical issues efficiently.
  • Collaborates with cross-functional teams to integrate frontend and backend components seamlessly.
  • Communicates effectively with team members, stakeholders and non-technical persons and also collaborates well within a team, sharing knowledge and mentoring junior developers.
  • Shows a strong commitment to learning and staying up to date with emerging technologies and industry trends.


Technology Requirements

  • 6+ years of experience as backend developer.
  • Proficient in Java 21, dependency injections frameworks, Relational and Non-Relational Databases.
  • Emphasizes the importance of testing, automated testing frameworks and writing unit tests.
  • Can design RESTful APIs, architect software systems (taking into consideration scalability, maintainability and performance).
  • Familiar with design patterns, microservices and other software design principles.
  • Familiar with DevOps practices (CI, CD and deployments pipelines). Utilizes tools like Git, Docker, and Kubernetes for development and deployment.
  • Experience working with integration of payment processing platforms, design, develop and optimize API connections to enable smooth payment workflows.
  • Experience with any scripting languages.


Profile Requirements

  • Ability to learn quickly and work independently.
  • Strong project management and interpersonal skills.
  • A team player who enjoys collaborating with others.
  • Experience in frontend development is a plus.

title: Remote Business Analyst - 57510
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems.

Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


About the Role:

We are looking for a detail-oriented Business Analyst to support evaluation and annotation workflows focused on quality, accuracy, and structured reasoning. This role is ideal for someone who is comfortable working with digital tools, performing side-by-side evaluations, and providing clear, well-supported justifications based on fact-checking.


Responsibilities:

  • Perform side-by-side (SxS) evaluations on GHD, comparing outputs and assessing quality, accuracy, and relevance.
  • Conduct fact-checking to validate information and identify inconsistencies or inaccuracies.
  • Provide detailed, well-structured justifications to support evaluation decisions.
  • Follow established evaluation guidelines and quality standards consistently.
  • Use browser-based tools and extensions to support analysis and review tasks.
  • Execute simple command-line instructions when required to support evaluation workflows.
  • Document findings clearly and communicate insights to stakeholders when needed.


Requirements:

  • Solid comfort using a computer in a professional setting.
  • Experience working with browser extensions and online tools.
  • Ability to run basic command-line commands (no advanced programming required).
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.
  • High attention to detail and ability to justify decisions clearly and objectively.
  • Comfortable working with evaluation frameworks, comparisons, and structured analysis.
  • Good written communication skills in English.


Nice to Have:

  • Previous experience with evaluation, annotation, QA, or audit-type work.
  • Familiarity with data quality, content evaluation, or model/output assessments.
  • Background in business analysis, operations, or process improvement.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to contribute to impactful research initiatives.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitment Required: 30 hours per week minimum.
  • Engagement Type: Contractor/Freelancer (no medical or paid leave).
  • Time Overlap: Some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2–5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles.


Application Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete an analytical challenge.
  • Once the assessment is cleared, you’re ready to start contributing!


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Ruby on Rails)
description:
About The Opportunity


We are looking for a highly experienced Senior Full-Stack Engineer to work on reverse supply chain processes, including trade-ins, recycling, repairs, and returns. The role involves maintaining and enhancing an existing Rails 6/7 application focused on electronic recyclables, covering inventory, scheduling, transportation, management, and processing.


Responsibilities


  • Design, develop, and maintain web applications and components using Ruby on Rails.
  • Build and integrate APIs with 3rd party companies and internal applications.
  • Collaborate with internal partners and external vendors to deliver scalable solutions.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve performance, response time, and capacity issues.
  • Maintain high-quality documentation and ensure data integrity across systems.
  • Perform both front-end (GUI) and back-end development tasks.


Required Qualifications


  • Strong experience with Ruby on Rails development
  • Strong expertise in API design and integration (JSON, ProtoBuf, REST, RPC, XML, etc).
  • Proficiency in front-end technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Bootstrap, JQuery).
  • Experience with Continuous Integration tools (CircleCI, Jenkins).

title: Senior Writer
description:
Senior Writer (Roteirista)

Location: Remote

Position Type: Contract

Company: Pocket FM


About Us

At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. We are looking for a strategic and creative Senior Writer to lead content development, drive show performance, and manage a team of writers across multiple audio series.


Role Overview

As a Senior Writer, you will be the end-to-end owner of multiple shows, responsible for their creative direction, content quality, and audience performance. You will lead a team of Junior Writers, oversee localization and adaptation workflows, and ensure that each show delivers strong engagement and retention. This role requires a blend of storytelling expertise, analytical thinking, and leadership to continuously optimize content from a user-first perspective.


Key Responsibilities

1. Show Ownership & Editorial Strategy

  • Own multiple shows end-to-end, from pre-editorial planning to post-release optimization.
  • Define show-level creative direction, narrative arcs, and long-term storytelling strategy.
  • Review and approve concept notes, localization approaches, and adaptation frameworks.
  • Ensure consistency in tone, character development, and narrative quality across episodes and seasons.

2. Content Development & Adaptation Oversight

  • Oversee script adaptation and localization workflows executed by Junior Writers.
  • Ensure all scripts meet editorial standards, cultural relevance, and storytelling depth.
  • Guide the use of GenAI tools for structured, high-quality script adaptation.
  • Provide detailed feedback and direction to refine scripts before production.

3. Team Management & Leadership

  • Manage and mentor a team of Junior Writers, each assigned to individual shows.
  • Review outputs, provide constructive feedback, and ensure consistent quality across the team.
  • Drive accountability, productivity, and skill development within the team.
  • Foster a strong creative culture focused on storytelling excellence and user impact.

4. Performance Monitoring & Optimization

  • Track and analyze show performance using key metrics such as user retention, listen duration, and conversion.
  • Identify underperforming episodes, story arcs, or shows and implement data-driven improvements.
  • Plan and execute show reworks based on audience behavior and feedback.
  • Continuously optimize content to maximize engagement and platform growth.

5. Production Collaboration & Quality Control

  • Provide feedback on voice-over, production quality, and final audio output.
  • Ensure alignment between scripts and produced audio content.
  • Collaborate with production, QC, and creative teams to maintain high-quality output.

6. User-Centric Content Improvement

  • Analyze user feedback, comments, and listening patterns to refine storytelling approaches.
  • Apply a strong user-first lens to identify gaps and solve content-related challenges.
  • Ensure content resonates with target audiences and drives long-term engagement.

7. Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Work closely with business, content, and production teams to align on show goals and performance targets.
  • Participate in weekly reviews with the business team to evaluate show progress and define action plans.
  • Communicate insights, risks, and opportunities effectively across stakeholders.

8. Promotion & Growth Strategy

  • Guide the development of promotional concepts and scripts for assigned shows.
  • Ensure promos align with the show’s narrative hook and audience appeal.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Literature, Creative Writing, Media, Communications, or a related field.
  • Proven experience in scriptwriting, content localization, or storytelling for audio/video platforms.
  • Strong leadership experience managing writers or creative teams.
  • Deep understanding of narrative structure, pacing, and audience engagement strategies.
  • Experience working with AI-based writing/adaptation tools is preferred.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret performance data and drive decisions.
  • Excellent communication, feedback, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple shows and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.


Key Traits for Success

  • Strong ownership mindset with end-to-end accountability for show performance
  • Ability to think from a user perspective and solve content challenges creatively
  • Leadership and mentoring capability to build high-performing writing teams
  • Understanding and crafting the workflow as new challenges arise
  • Balance of creativity and data-driven decision-making

title: Investment Banking Intern
description:
Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program

Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.


We are actively screening thousands of top students globally to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in partnership with leading boutique investment banks in key markets, including the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.


Only two students are selected per quarter for this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region.


What You'll Gain:

  • Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2): The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including:
  • 3-Statement Financial Modeling
  • Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis
  • Trading Comparables (Comps)
  • Precedent Transactions
  • Advanced Excel & PowerPoint techniques
  • Industry Research & Sourcing Strategies
  • Real-World Experience (Weeks 3-10): Following successful completion of the initial training and assessments, you'll be introduced to a Managing Director or Partner at one of our boutique investment bank partners. For the next eight weeks, you'll work directly on live projects, providing invaluable support with:
  • Pitch Book Development
  • Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs)
  • Financial Modeling
  • Sourcing & Due Diligence
  • Industry and Company Research
  • And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals.
  • Mentorship & Feedback: Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing.


This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals.


Who We're Looking For:

This program is ideal for highly motivated 1st year and 2nd year students (not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who are hungry, quick learners, and committed to excelling in a fast-paced environment.


How to Apply:

Get your application in now! If selected, you will be invited to complete a short assessment. Top candidates from this assessment will move forward to the intensive training phase.

This is your chance to gain an unparalleled edge in your finance career. We look forward to reviewing your application!
